Privacy

The short version: this game doesn't have accounts, doesn't ask for your name or email, and doesn't send your gameplay anywhere. Your unlocked weapons, colors, and star count are saved only on this device, in your browser's local storage — we never see them.

If you clear your browser data or switch devices, that progress won't carry over, because there's nowhere else it's kept.

This game is hosted on a game portal, and that portal may show ads and use its own tools to do so. Those are run by the portal, not by us, and follow the portal's own privacy policy — worth a look if you want the full picture on ads.

That's really it. No hidden tracking, no data broker, no fine print designed to bury the point.
